description: This file defines a SearchFragment class for an Android app, which provides UI and logic for searching notes by title or content. It manages search input, displays search results in a RecyclerView, and interacts with a notes repository.

classes.name: SearchFragment
classes.description: A fragment that provides search functionality for notes, including UI components like search input, recycler view for results, and empty view label.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and sets up the NoteSelectionListener, and the notes repository.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Clears the NoteSelectionListener reference to avoid leaks.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, sets up UI components, recycler view, adapter, and text change listener to trigger search.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Refreshes the search results when the fragment resumes.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Public method to refresh the search results based on current input.

methods.name: performSearch
methods.description: Performs search with the provided query and updates the UI with results.
